description:
List the ads (creatives) of the Google Ads Transparency Center by advertiser or by the
        website they promote, with first/last shown dates, format and creative.

        Cost: 1 credit per call, whatever the number of ads returned (an empty result too);
        an error costs 0. The next page is a new call (1 credit).

        Args:
            advertiser_id: Advertiser ID (AR..., see search_google_advertisers).
            domain: Website the ads point to (e.g. 'nike.com'). advertiser_id or domain is required.
            region: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country where the ads were shown, or 'ALL' (default).
            format: 'all' (default), 'text', 'image' or 'video'.
            active_from: YYYY-MM-DD; ads shown on or after this date.
            active_to: YYYY-MM-DD; ads shown on or before this date.
            limit: Ads per page, 1-40 (default 10).
            cursor: next_cursor from a previous call, to get the next page (same filters).
name: search_google_ads
title: Search Google ads
